description:
Constructor University (previously known as Jacobs University Bremen) is a private, residential, and multinational university situated in Vegesack, Bremen, Germany. It provides undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs in engineering, humanities, natural sciences, and social sciences. English is the primary language of instruction at the institution. More than 110 different nations are represented among Constructor University's student body, with about 80% of them being foreigners and about 33% of the staff being from other countries. From its mission statement, Constructor University has deduced three key goals for its educational profile academic excellence, individual development and employability.

A wide range of interdisciplinary study options is available at Constructor University, covering everything from the social sciences and economics to the natural sciences, mathematics, and engineering.  In order to be eligible to study at CU Bremen (Jacobs University as its former name) as an undergraduate student, you need to verify certain documents.  These documents include a valid passport, a school leaving certificate that allows you to pursue higher education in Germany, a portfolio, and an English test score which is generally accepted as IELTS. A minimum score of 6.0 from IELTS is required at CU Bremen. However, other language tests like the Pearson Test of English (PTE) or TOEFL IBT can also be taken. The minimum required score for PTE is 59 while the minimum required score for TOEFL IBT is 85. Please be aware that some study programs which are focused on arts or design may require you to take an additional entrance exam. Moreover, if you want to study Engineering or Management, the school may require taking SAT.

There are several postgraduate programs at Constructor University ranging from MA in International Relations to Data Engineering, Computer Science and Software Engineering, and, Supply Chain Management. The postgraduate programs generally take two years. To be eligible, it is important to have a high GPA record in your Bachelor’s degree. Also, requirements include a minimum IELTS score of 6.5 or a minimum TOEFL IBT score of 90 for postgraduate courses.  Moreover, a letter of motivation, CV/ Updated resume, and two letters of recommendation are also demanded by the university for postgraduate admission.
